# PDV Diegetic UX — Sample Sheet

**Status:** Sample / mockup. Companion to `PDV_ImmersiveUX_DiegeticSurfaces_Buildout.md`.
**Date:** 2026-06-05

A concrete "what does each surface actually look like" pass. The **visuals** are palette-accurate
mockups (same SVG→cairosvg pipeline + gold/parchment palette as the Prisma instrument art); the
**text** below is literal sample copy you could ship. These are mockups, not in-game captures — in
game each renders via its named tool.

**Images** (generated by `scratch/prisma-art/ux_samples.py`):
- `scratch/prisma-art/ux_samples_contactsheet.png` — every Tier B surface, tiled.
- `scratch/prisma-art/ux_samples_cursecure.png` — "one moment, all channels" composite.

To keep the samples coherent they follow **one player**: a Khajiit who drifts toward **Khenarthi**
(moon/wind), is later struck by a **vampiric curse**, and is eventually **cured**.

---

## B1 · Living Medallion (Description Framework, MISC item — hover text)

The medallion's hover-description *is* the status read. Three sample states:

**Devoted (heard recently)**
> **Medallion of Khenarthi**
> Favor: **Devoted**.
> The wind carries your name.
> Last heard: this dawn.

**Neglected (slipping)**
> **Medallion (dimmed)**
> Favor: **Faithful**, slipping.
> Unheard for **six days**.
> Pray, or offer on the road.

**Cursed (silenced)**
> **Medallion (shadowed)**
> Favor: **silent**.
> A curse stands between
> you and the sky.

*Tone rule:* rich text is fine here — the player *chose* to look. This is the safe home for the
otherwise-opaque numbers (Breton Integrity, exposure proximity) without putting them in notifications.

---

## B2 · The Book of Days (Dynamic Book Framework — self-writing journal)

One dated, in-voice line per transition; routine favor is a single dawn digest line. Sample page:

> *The Book of Days*
> ───────────────
> *17th Last Seed — dawn* — The day's small devotions noted; the road was kept.
> *19th Last Seed* — You reached *Devoted*. The pantheon turns to look.
> *24th Last Seed* — Six days of silence. Khenarthi's wind has stilled around you.
> *2nd Hearthfire* — Cold takes you. The moons close their eyes — a curse is on you.
> *9th Hearthfire* — The scar closes. The sky is yours again; she hears you once more.

*This is where the neglect-cadence rule lives:* one line per tier-drop, none again until recovery —
the slip is legible once, not nagged.

---

## B3 + B4 · Screen states (effect shaders + imagespace modifiers)

Wordless, ≤~1.5s, fired on the transition's tonal peak. The five sampled tones:

| Moment | Imagespace | Aura / shader |
|---|---|---|
| **Tier reached** | warm gold bloom | brief gold rings around the player |
| **Patron emergence** | white "revelation" bloom | a rising sun-mark above the figure |
| **Neglect onset** | slow grey desaturate | — |
| **Curse onset** | cold blue vignette | cold shroud + a sundered ring mark |
| **Curse cure** | clearing green fade | cleansing green shimmer rings |

*Tool note:* imagespace is **pure vanilla** (`ImageSpaceModifier.Apply`); the aura is a self-target
spell carrying an EFSH/ARTO, or po3 PE direct. Rare and short — a lingering shader reads as a bug.

---

## B5 · Favor you can hear (sound + music)

Audio is illustrated in the sheet, not audible. Sample cue bank:

- **Favor noted** → a soft ascending chime (off by default; opt-in).
- **Disfavor / taboo** → a hollow, falling tone.
- **Patron swell** → a low rising musical bed when praying at a patron shrine.
- **Full-moon tell** (Khajiit) → a distinct quiet motif on full-moon nights, on the verified 8-phase
  clock — surfacing the moon cycle the audit says is currently invisible.

One cue per *transition*, never per piety tick.

---

## B6 · Devotion performed (bundled OAR prayer animation)

A four-beat rite, shipped as a **PDV-owned OAR submod** (only the OAR engine is required):

**approach → kneel → offer → rise**

The offer beat is where the EventBus fires (the existing token/shrine routes). Race-specific postures
(Dunmer ash-shrine, Orc forge dedication, Khajiit moon rite) are just different submod conditions over
the same trigger. Skippable/interruptible; never a long forced lock.

---

## B7 · Marks on the body (RaceMenu / NiOverride overlays — baseline)

Tied strictly to *major* embodied states, so a mark always means something:

- **Curse scar** — appears on onset, **fades on cure** (paired with the B3 cleansing shimmer).
- **Champion warpaint** — appears at Champion tier.
- **Ancestor ash** — deep Dunmer ancestor depth.

---

## B8 · The world recognizes you (SPID stance — non-voiced, V1-legal)

Disposition shifts keyed off PDV's existing devotion globals — **no new lines, no voice**:

- **Priest of Khenarthi** → disposition warms ↑ as your favor rises.
- **Zealot of a rival god** → disposition cools ↓.

They simply treat you as your faith has earned. Spoken recognition stays V2 (voiced).

---

## The money shot — one moment, every channel (Curse Cure)

See `ux_samples_cursecure.png`. The cure is the audit's universally-silent moment (C2). Diegetically
it becomes: **clearing green imagespace + cleansing aura (B4+B3) + rising chime (B5) + medallion
brightens (B1) + scar fades (B7) + a Book of Days line (B2)** — and, because a cure is a *true
transition*, the one push surface that stays: a single MessageBox in the god's voice:

> **— Khenarthi —**
> The shadow lifts. The moons open their eyes upon you once more, and the wind remembers your name.
> Walk on, and keep faith.
> *[ Continue ]*

Routine favor would get **none** of this push layer — just the silent journal digest. That contrast
*is* the design: loud only when it earns it.

---

## How notifications/toasts fare in these samples (recap)

- **MessageBoxes stay** for genuine decisions / major changes (curse, Champion, commitment offers).
- **Prisma overlay toasts demote** to an MCM verbosity option (Silent / Transitions-only / Verbose),
  not deleted.
- **Routine HUD notifications default to silent** → journal digest + optional chime.

So in the default ("Silent"/diegetic) profile sampled above, the only on-glass push you see is the
MessageBox at the cure — everything else is in the world, the item, the book, the body, or the score.

---

## Regenerating / iterating

```bash
cd scratch/prisma-art && python3 ux_samples.py   # needs cairosvg
```
Edit copy/colors at the top of `ux_samples.py`; tile functions are `t_*`, the composite is
`curse_cure_composite()`. Palette constants match `instruments.py`.
